Name: Animated Festive Tappers
Author: sproggen
Description:
A small mod to retexture the clunky default tree tapper. Requires "Alternative Textures" to work, use the paintbucket tool on a tree tapper in game to change it. Once the texture is applied it will automatically change to a new festive animation for each season. Enjoy!

Includes two files, heavy tapper and normal tapper.

The beautiful map recolour in the images is from DaisyNiko's "Earthy Recolour" mod.

Downloads.Description: Unzip file and drag contents straight into your Mods folder
